vocabulary.collocation: draw up a shortlist of universities

paraphrases.note: institution 较正式；where to study 更适合口语。
paraphrases.translation: 选择大学可以表达为选择机构、决定在哪里学习、做出大学选择。

paraphrases.note: prestigious 指声誉高，不等于适合个人。
paraphrases.translation: 一所著名大学可以表示为一所享有声望的机构、一所排名很高的大学、一所备受推崇的大学。

paraphrases.note: module 指学位中的具体课程单元。
paraphrases.translation: 课程内容可以表示为课程结构、学位模块、课程涵盖的内容。

paraphrases.note: full cost 应同时考虑学费与生活费。
paraphrases.translation: 大学费用可以表示为全部学习费用、学费和生活费、财务承诺。

paraphrases.note: open day 是大学集中接待申请者的开放日。
paraphrases.translation: 申请前参观可以表现为参加开放日、参观校园、亲自探索设施。

paraphrases.note: fit 强调个人与课程的匹配。
paraphrases.translation: 适合我可以表达为良好的学术契合、符合我的需求、与我的兴趣相匹配。
未来的就业前景可以表现为毕业生就业前景、职业成果、学位后机会。

paraphrases.note: weigh up 表示综合权衡利弊。
paraphrases.translation: 比较大学可以表示为权衡机构、评估替代课程、比较可用选项。

sentences.pattern: Whether + university option + is suitable depends largely on + criterion.
sentences.cn: 某个大学选择是否合适，很大程度上取决于某项标准。
sentences.example: Whether a distant university is suitable depends largely on the support a student can access.
sentences.exampleTranslation: 距离较远的大学是否合适很大程度上取决于学生可以获得的支持。

sentences.pattern: Rather than choosing + option + solely on the basis of + factor, applicants should + action.
sentences.cn: 申请者不应只根据某因素选择……，而应……。
sentences.example: Rather than choosing a course solely on the basis of prestige, applicants should examine its content.
sentences.exampleTranslation: 申请人不应仅根据声誉来选择课程，而应检查其内容。

sentences.pattern: The more accurately + applicants + assess + needs, the less likely they are to + negative result.
sentences.cn: 申请者越准确评估自身需要，就越不容易……。
sentences.example: The more accurately applicants assess their needs, the less likely they are to leave a course early.
sentences.exampleTranslation: 申请者越准确地评估他们的需求，他们提前离开课程的可能性就越小。

expressions.example: I need time to weigh up my options before accepting an offer.
expressions.exampleTranslation: 接受录取通知前，我需要时间权衡各种选择。

expressions.example: I had my heart set on studying in a coastal city.
expressions.exampleTranslation: 我一心想在沿海城市学习。

expressions.example: I applied to several programmes to keep my options open.
expressions.exampleTranslation: 我申请了几个项目，以便保留多种选择。

expressions.example: Applicants must meet the entry requirements before they are interviewed.
expressions.exampleTranslation: 申请人在面试前必须满足入学要求。

expressions.example: Open days help students make an informed choice about where to study.
expressions.exampleTranslation: 开放日帮助学生就去哪里学习做出明智的选择。

mistakes.wrong: I want to enter to a good university.
mistakes.correct: I want to get into a good university.
mistakes.why: enter 作“进入”时不接 to；谈录取更自然地用 get into。

mistakes.wrong: The course contains many practical works.
mistakes.correct: The course includes a lot of practical work.
mistakes.why: work 表示学习或工作内容时通常不可数。

mistakes.wrong: I am considering to study abroad.
mistakes.why: consider 后接动名词，不接不定式。

writingIdeas.viewpoint: Course content should outweigh institutional prestige.
writingIdeas.topicSentence: Applicants should judge a degree primarily by what and how they will study.
writingIdeas.argument: A famous university cannot compensate for a programme that does not suit a student’s interests or preferred way of learning. Module descriptions reveal whether a course is theoretical, practical or flexible, while assessment methods show what work will be expected. A student who enjoys laboratory investigation may struggle on a programme dominated by lectures and final examinations. Careful comparison also reduces the risk of changing degrees after considerable expense. Prestige has value, but educational fit should guide the final decision.
writingIdeas.viewpointTranslation: 课程内容应该超越机构声誉。
writingIdeas.topicSentenceTranslation: 申请人应主要根据学习内容和学习方式来判断学位。

argumentSentences.text: A famous university cannot compensate for a programme that does not suit a student’s interests or preferred way of learning.
argumentSentences.translation: 著名大学无法补偿不适合学生兴趣或首选学习方式的课程。

argumentSentences.text: Module descriptions reveal whether a course is theoretical, practical or flexible, while assessment methods show what work will be expected.
argumentSentences.translation: 模块描述揭示了课程是理论的、实践的还是灵活的，而评估方法则表明了预期的工作内容。

argumentSentences.text: A student who enjoys laboratory investigation may struggle on a programme dominated by lectures and final examinations.
argumentSentences.translation: 喜欢实验室研究的学生可能会在以讲座和期末考试为主的课程中遇到困难。

argumentSentences.text: Careful comparison also reduces the risk of changing degrees after considerable expense.
argumentSentences.translation: 仔细比较还可以降低在花费大量费用后改变学位的风险。

argumentSentences.text: Prestige has value, but educational fit should guide the final decision.
argumentSentences.translation: 声望是有价值的，但教育背景应该指导最终的决定。

writingIdeas.viewpoint: Financial planning is part of a responsible university choice.
writingIdeas.topicSentence: The full cost of study should be considered before an applicant accepts a university place.
writingIdeas.argument: Tuition is only one component of university expense, since housing, transport and materials can vary sharply between locations. Underestimating these costs may force students into excessive paid work and reduce the time available for study. Applicants should compare realistic monthly budgets and investigate grants before committing themselves. Choosing a less expensive city can sometimes provide greater academic freedom than attending a prestigious institution under constant financial pressure. Transparent cost information is therefore essential to fair access.
writingIdeas.viewpointTranslation: 财务规划是负责任的大学选择的一部分。
writingIdeas.topicSentenceTranslation: 申请人在接受大学录取之前应考虑全部学习费用。

argumentSentences.text: Tuition is only one component of university expense, since housing, transport and materials can vary sharply between locations.
argumentSentences.translation: 学费只是大学费用的一部分，因为不同地点的住房、交通和材料差异很大。

argumentSentences.text: Underestimating these costs may force students into excessive paid work and reduce the time available for study.
argumentSentences.translation: 低估这些成本可能会迫使学生从事过多的有偿工作并减少可用于学习的时间。

argumentSentences.text: Applicants should compare realistic monthly budgets and investigate grants before committing themselves.
argumentSentences.translation: 申请人应在做出承诺之前比较现实的每月预算并调查补助金。

argumentSentences.text: Choosing a less expensive city can sometimes provide greater academic freedom than attending a prestigious institution under constant financial pressure.
argumentSentences.translation: 选择生活成本较低的城市有时比在持续的财务压力下就读著名院校提供更大的学术自由。

argumentSentences.text: Transparent cost information is therefore essential to fair access.
argumentSentences.translation: 因此，透明的成本信息对于公平访问至关重要。

speaking.question: What would matter most to you when choosing a university?
speaking.answer: The course itself would come first. I would look at the actual modules and how they are assessed, because an impressive name would not help if I disliked the daily work. Location would still matter, especially the cost of housing and the time needed to travel home. I would probably make a shortlist only after comparing all three factors.
speaking.questionTranslation: 当你选择大学时，什么对你来说最重要？

answerSentences.text: The course itself would come first.
I would look at the actual modules and how they are assessed, because an impressive name would not help if I disliked the daily work.
answerSentences.translation: 我会查看具体课程模块及其考核方式，因为如果我不喜欢每天真正要做的学习内容，再响亮的课程名称也没有用。

answerSentences.text: Location would still matter, especially the cost of housing and the time needed to travel home.
answerSentences.translation: 地点仍然很重要，尤其是住房费用和回家所需的时间。

answerSentences.text: I would probably make a shortlist only after comparing all three factors.
answerSentences.translation: 我大概会在比较完这三个因素后才列出候选学校。

speaking.question: Describe a difficult educational choice you made or may need to make.
speaking.answer: A choice I may have to make is whether to study close to home or move to another city. Staying nearby would be cheaper, and I could keep my present support network. The other course, however, offers a specialist module that fits my interests much better. I would speak to current students and calculate a realistic budget before deciding. It is difficult because the academically stronger option also involves more uncertainty and independence. I would also compare the amount of teaching in small groups, because published rankings would not answer that personal question. Moving away could help me become independent, yet loneliness might affect my study at first. Whichever option I choose, I want the decision to rest on daily realities rather than the excitement of a campus visit.
speaking.questionTranslation: 描述您做出或可能需要做出的艰难的教育选择。

answerSentences.text: A choice I may have to make is whether to study close to home or move to another city.
answerSentences.translation: 我可能必须做出的选择是是在离家近的地方学习还是搬到另一个城市。

answerSentences.text: Staying nearby would be cheaper, and I could keep my present support network.
answerSentences.translation: 住在附近会更便宜，而且我可以保留现有的支持网络。

answerSentences.text: The other course, however, offers a specialist module that fits my interests much better.
answerSentences.translation: 然而，另一门课程提供了更适合我兴趣的专业模块。

answerSentences.text: I would speak to current students and calculate a realistic budget before deciding.
answerSentences.translation: 在做出决定之前，我会与当前的学生交谈并计算出现实的预算。

answerSentences.text: It is difficult because the academically stronger option also involves more uncertainty and independence.
answerSentences.translation: 这很困难，因为学术上更强的选择也涉及更多的不确定性和独立性。

answerSentences.text: I would also compare the amount of teaching in small groups, because published rankings would not answer that personal question.
answerSentences.translation: 我还会比较小组教学的数量，因为公布的排名无法回答这个个人问题。

answerSentences.text: Moving away could help me become independent, yet loneliness might affect my study at first.
answerSentences.translation: 搬走可以帮助我变得独立，但孤独一开始可能会影响我的学习。

answerSentences.text: Whichever option I choose, I want the decision to rest on daily realities rather than the excitement of a campus visit.
answerSentences.translation: 无论最终选择哪一个，我都希望依据日常生活的实际情况作决定，而不是被参观校园时的兴奋感左右。

reading.title: Why University Rankings Cannot Make the Decision
paragraphs: University league tables turn a complex institution into a position on a list. For applicants facing hundreds of possible courses, that simplicity is attractive. A high rank appears to promise excellent teaching, respected qualifications and strong employment prospects. Yet the number is an aggregate: it combines indicators chosen for a broad audience, whereas an individual student has a particular subject, budget and preferred learning environment.

The measures themselves deserve attention. Research income may indicate an active academic department, but undergraduates do not necessarily work with its leading researchers. Student-satisfaction surveys capture experience, although responses can be influenced by expectations and by events unrelated to teaching. Graduate salaries favour courses linked to highly paid occupations and universities located in expensive labour markets. None of these indicators is useless; the problem arises when different evidence is treated as a single judgement of quality.

Rankings can also alter institutional behaviour. When a measure becomes influential, universities have an incentive to improve the figure, sometimes without improving the underlying experience to the same extent. Resources may be directed towards visible facilities or selective admission because these affect reputation. By contrast, careful feedback on first-year assignments or support for commuting students is harder to advertise, despite its importance to daily study.

A more reliable selection process begins with questions rather than positions. Applicants can compare compulsory modules, contact hours, assessment types and opportunities for practical experience. They may ask current students how quickly staff respond when difficulties arise. Cost and accessibility should be calculated for the whole degree, not only the first term. A ranking can identify institutions worth investigating, but it cannot decide whether a specific person will flourish there. The final choice requires evidence at the level of the course and the learner.

Applicants should also treat published information as a starting point that needs interpretation. Two courses may report similar contact hours while organising them differently: one uses large lectures and another small laboratories. Visiting, asking precise questions and comparing written answers can expose these differences. The decision improves when a broad indicator leads to closer enquiry instead of replacing it.

reading.titleTranslation: 为什么大学排名无法做出决定

paragraphSentencePairs.text: University league tables turn a complex institution into a position on a list.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 大学排行榜将复杂的机构变成了排行榜上的一个位置。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: For applicants facing hundreds of possible courses, that simplicity is attractive.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 对于面临数百门可能课程的申请者来说，这种简单性很有吸引力。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: A high rank appears to promise excellent teaching, respected qualifications and strong employment prospects.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 高排名似乎意味着优秀的教学、受人尊敬的资格和良好的就业前景。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Yet the number is an aggregate: it combines indicators chosen for a broad audience, whereas an individual student has a particular subject, budget and preferred learning environment.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 然而，这个数字是一个总量：它结合了为广大受众选择的指标，而个别学生则有特定的科目、预算和首选的学习环境。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: The measures themselves deserve attention.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 这些措施本身值得关注。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Research income may indicate an active academic department, but undergraduates do not necessarily work with its leading researchers.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 研究收入可能表明学术部门很活跃，但本科生不一定与其领先的研究人员一起工作。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Student-satisfaction surveys capture experience, although responses can be influenced by expectations and by events unrelated to teaching.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 学生满意度调查捕捉经验，尽管反应可能受到期望和与教学无关的事件的影响。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Graduate salaries favour courses linked to highly paid occupations and universities located in expensive labour markets.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 毕业生的薪资偏向于与高薪职业相关的课程以及位于昂贵劳动力市场的大学。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: None of these indicators is useless; the problem arises when different evidence is treated as a single judgement of quality.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 这些指标没有一个是无用的；当不同的证据被视为单一的质量判断时，就会出现问题。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Rankings can also alter institutional behaviour.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 排名还可以改变机构行为。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: When a measure becomes influential, universities have an incentive to improve the figure, sometimes without improving the underlying experience to the same extent.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 当一项措施变得有影响力时，大学就有动力去改善这个数字，有时却不会在同等程度上改善基本体验。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Resources may be directed towards visible facilities or selective admission because these affect reputation.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 资源可能会被定向到可见的设施或选择性入场，因为这些会影响声誉。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: By contrast, careful feedback on first-year assignments or support for commuting students is harder to advertise, despite its importance to daily study.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 相比之下，对第一年作业的认真反馈或对通勤学生的支持则更难宣传，尽管它对日常学习很重要。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: A more reliable selection process begins with questions rather than positions.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 更可靠的选择过程始于问题而不是职位。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Applicants can compare compulsory modules, contact hours, assessment types and opportunities for practical experience.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 申请人可以比较必修模块、接触时间、评估类型和实践经验的机会。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: They may ask current students how quickly staff respond when difficulties arise.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 他们可能会询问当前的学生，当出现困难时，工作人员的反应速度有多快。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Cost and accessibility should be calculated for the whole degree, not only the first term.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 成本和可及性应该针对整个学位进行计算，而不仅仅是第一个学期。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: A ranking can identify institutions worth investigating, but it cannot decide whether a specific person will flourish there.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 排名可以确定值得研究的机构，但不能决定特定的人是否会在那里蓬勃发展。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: The final choice requires evidence at the level of the course and the learner.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 最终的选择需要课程和学习者层面的证据。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Applicants should also treat published information as a starting point that needs interpretation.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 申请人还应将已发布的信息视为需要解释的起点。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Two courses may report similar contact hours while organising them differently: one uses large lectures and another small laboratories.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 两门课程可能报告相似的接触时间，但组织方式不同：一门使用大型讲座，另一门使用小型实验室。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Visiting, asking precise questions and comparing written answers can expose these differences.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 拜访、提出精确问题并比较书面答案可以暴露这些差异。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: The decision improves when a broad indicator leads to closer enquiry instead of replacing it.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 当广泛的指标导致更深入的调查而不是取代它时，决策就会得到改善。
